faceCleanup: Keep the largest connected alpha island; discard neighboring UV fragment.
pawUpCleanup: Clip atlas UV region to its paw mesh contour.
glows: Keep original cyan RGBA where g>100, b>100, r<170 and min(g-r,b-r)>45.
originalResources: Backgrounds, covers and complete per-key PNGs are copied byte-for-byte.
